graph.title: LEGO 4991-1 Police Helicopter

edges.method: hinge.1 to hinge.1 (thin top plate on hinge base)
axle.1 through axle-hole.1 of Technic brick
round plate pressed onto the camera piece
clip.1 on a bar of the skid area
clip.1 on a bar of the skid area

notes: The minifigure (head, helmet, torso, legs) is not in the piece list, so it is not recorded.
The booklet has four sub-assembly boxes, so I counted steps as: 1, 2, 3, then sub 4 (p9), sub 5 (hinge p14+p15), main step 6, sub 7 (axle arm), main step 8, sub 9 (p17+p26), main step 10.

Fix for the reported problems: p20 and p21 are brick-high (3 plates), so they run from layer 4 to layer 7. I moved the blue round plates p24 and p25 up to layer 7, at the end cell of each skid piece. Each now sits on top of its skid piece and no longer overlaps it.
The grid positions are my best estimate from small drawings. The skid pieces p20 and p21, the Technic stack, and the windscreen p23 are the least certain.
I assumed the hinge base p14 sits on p9 and tile p1 sits on p14. The hinge top plate p15 is only hinged, so it has no grid position.
Clip attachment points for p16 and p17 are unclear in the drawings. I assumed they clip onto the skid pieces p20 and p21.
The small yellow round plate p26 goes on p17.
